title: Recursive State-Augmented Language Models: Persistent Latent-State Adaptation of Pretrained Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.16375v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Language models rely on finite token contexts, limiting access to earlier interactions. We introduce Recursive State-Augmented Language Models (Recursive SALM), a framework in which a persistent latent state evolves with each observation and generates adaptations of a pretrained language model. A modular read-transition-write architecture separates observation encoding, latent dynamics, and predictor adaptation. We develop deterministic and stochastic formulations.   The experiments evaluate only deterministic SALM with frozen GPT-2 small and exclude earlier evidence from its decoder context. On a four-turn hypothesis-inference task, latent-gated LoRA reaches 89.1% accuracy, comparable to 88.0% for a trained full-context LoRA baseline, with earlier evidence available solely through a 64-dimensional state. translated_title: 递归状态增强语言模型：预训练语言模型的持久潜在状态自适应
translated_abstract: 语言模型依赖于有限的词元上下文，这限制了对早期交互信息的获取。我们提出了递归状态增强语言模型，这是一个框架：其中持久的潜在状态随每次观测而演化，并生成对预训练语言模型的自适应调整。模块化的“读取-转移-写入”架构将观测编码、潜在状态动态与预测器自适应分离开来。我们开发了确定性与随机两种形式的表述。实验仅评估了采用冻结 GPT-2 small 的确定性 SALM，并将其解码器上下文中的早期证据排除在外。在一项四轮假设-推理任务中，潜在门控 LoRA 达到了 89.1% 的准确率，与使用完整上下文训练的 LoRA 基线（88.0%）相当，而早期证据仅通过一个 64 维的状态来提供。将状态置零或打乱会显著降低准确率。在一项包含训练中未见过的码词的两轮任务中，若干接口……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出递归状态增强语言模型（Recursive SALM），通过随每次观测持续演化的持久潜在状态为冻结的预训练语言模型生成自适应调整，仅凭 64 维状态即可达到与使用完整上下文的基线相当的准确率。
en_tdlr: Recursive SALM introduces a persistent latent state that evolves with each observation to generate adaptations of a frozen pretrained language model, achieving accuracy comparable to full-context baselines using only a 64-dimensional state.
